description: This bar chart illustrates the average performance values for different models: Self-Instruct, Self-RAG, FactTune, FactTuneCinGS (w/), and ClinGS. The horizontal axis displays the model names in alphabetical order, with labels including “Self-Instruct”, “Self-RAG”, “FactTune”, “FactTuneCinGS (w/)”, and “ClinGS”. The vertical axis, labeled “Average Performance”, represents a linear scale ranging from 10 to 70, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Five individual bars are present, each corresponding to a model. The “Self-Instruct” bar is colored orange and extends to approximately 52. The “Self-RAG” bar is colored light green and reaches a value of approximately 62. The “FactTune” bar is colored green and extends to approximately 65. The “FactTuneCinGS (w/)" bar is colored blue and reaches a value of approximately 72. Finally, the “ClinGS” bar is colored dark blue and extends to approximately 75. No bars are visually emphasized, and there is no grouping or stacking of bars.
